units.source_text: 且说薰大将每届秋色渐深之时，似乎已成习惯，总是夜夜失眠，想念大女公子，不胜悲恸。

en.t: Now, whenever the autumn colors deepened, General Kaoru seemed to fall into an old habit: night after night he could not sleep, and he grieved unbearably as he thought of the elder princess.

units.source_text: 宇治新建的佛寺恰好在此时落成，他就亲自前往察看。

en.t: Just at this time, the newly built Buddhist temple at Uji was completed, so he went there in person to inspect it.

units.source_text: 久不来访，但觉山中红叶特别可爱。

en.t: Since he had not visited for a long time, the red leaves in the mountains seemed especially lovely to him.

units.source_text: 拆毁了的山庄的基地上，今已另建新屋，备极华丽。

en.t: On the site of the demolished mountain villa, a new building had now been constructed, and it was exceedingly splendid.

units.source_text: 想起已故八亲王所建原来的山庄简单朴素，犹似高僧的居处，不胜依恋，便觉新建的屋宇改变模样，甚是可惜。

en.t: When he remembered how simple and plain the original villa built by the late Eighth Prince had been, almost like the dwelling of a holy monk, he could not help longing for it, and felt it deeply regrettable that the newly built house had changed its appearance.

units.source_text: 因此感慨之情比往日更深。

en.t: For that reason, his feelings of melancholy were deeper than ever before.

units.source_text: 原来的山庄中的装饰设备，并不全体一律，有一部分非常庄严，另一部分十分纤丽，宜于女眷居住。

en.t: The furnishings and arrangements in the original villa had not all been of one kind: one part was very solemn, while another was delicate and graceful, well suited to the residence of women.

units.source_text: 现在把竹编屏风等粗率的家具移送新建的佛寺中供僧众使用，

en.t: Now the rougher furnishings, such as bamboo-woven screens, had been moved to the newly built Buddhist temple for the monks to use,

units.source_text: 这里另行新制山乡风味的器什，然而并不简陋，非常优美而富有趣致。

en.t: while here they had newly made utensils with the flavor of a mountain village; yet they were not crude, but very elegant and full of charm.

units.source_text: 薰大将坐在池塘旁边的岩石上流连观赏，一时不肯起立，即景赋诗云：

en.t: General Kaoru sat on a rock beside the pond, lingering over the view and unwilling to rise for a while; moved by the scene, he composed a poem:
